case1.title: ESG Tracking & Dashboard for SET100 Food Company
case1.summary: Implemented a comprehensive ESG tracking system and executive dashboard for a leading SET100 food and beverage company to monitor sustainability activities under global standards.
case1.challenge: NSL Foods PLC needed a centralized platform to track ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) activities across operations, ensure compliance with global sustainability standards, and provide clear reporting for committee and board-level decision making.
case1.solution: We developed a user-friendly web platform with intuitive UX/UI that enables staff to easily input ESG data across all sustainability metrics. The system includes real-time dashboards designed specifically for executive committees and board members to monitor progress and make informed decisions.
case1.results: Streamlined ESG data collection across the organization, real-time visibility into sustainability KPIs, board-ready reports aligned with global ESG standards, and improved governance transparency for stakeholders.

case2.title: R&D Performance Executive Dashboard for Food Manufacturer
case2.summary: Developed a real-time executive dashboard to monitor R&D activities, track project milestones, and optimize research investments for a SET100 food and beverage company.
case2.challenge: NSL Foods PLC faced challenges in monitoring their substantial R&D expenditures, which represent a significant cost center in the food and beverage industry. Executives needed better visibility into R&D team workloads, project progress, milestone achievements, and overall research performance to make informed investment decisions.
case2.solution: We created an intuitive real-time dashboard with user-friendly infographics that executives can easily interpret. The system tracks R&D workload distribution, goal accomplishment rates, milestone progress, and resource utilization across all research projects, enabling data-driven oversight of R&D operations.
case2.results: Enhanced executive visibility into R&D performance, improved milestone tracking and accountability, better resource allocation decisions, real-time monitoring of research investments, and clearer communication between R&D teams and executive leadership.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: D2Infinite was founded with a clear mission: to bridge the gap between complex data and executive decision-making. We recognized that organizations possess vast amounts of data, but often struggle to transform it into actionable insights.
story.p2: Our team combines deep expertise in data analytics, web development, and business intelligence to create solutions that speak the language of decision-makers. We don't just build dashboards; we craft decision support systems that drive real business outcomes.
story.p3: Today, we partner with organizations across manufacturing, retail, logistics, healthcare, and financial services to deliver infographic reports and real-time dashboards that turn data into competitive advantage.
